headline: Hyperia City hits shelves: Emerald-Steel leads early Core meta while Amber-Amethyst takes Heroes Ink

tldr.text: Hyperia City (Set 14) went on sale at all retailers on October 23, a week after its October 16 prerelease. Players report it is easy to find at or under MSRP.
The first Hyperia City Core Constructed meta report puts Emerald-Steel Evasive on top at about 23% of the field. Amber-Emerald Circle is next at about 15%, followed by Amber-Sapphire Princesses.
TT_Egelim won Heroes Ink 'Chapter 14 - Page 1' in Germany (36 players) with Amber-Amethyst. Amber-Emerald Songs won Top Deck Keep the same weekend.

Ravensburger confirmed Collector Boosters and a new serialized Illustrious rarity for Into the Inkdark on February 12, 2027. They will only be sold through Play Hub stores, Ravensburger's online store and some Disney locations.
The Quest World Iconic Clash, a Top 16 invitational and one of the first high-level Set 14 events, is releasing its Round 1 matches on JDZ Quest's channel.

meta.text: Emerald-Steel Evasive is the early deck to beat at about 23% of the Core field. It also did well at the 27-player Quest Coast IV, where Detectives and Princesses decks made the top cut too.
Amber-Emerald is everywhere. At Heroes Ink it took 2nd as an aggro build and had two more lists as Songs. At Top Deck Keep, Songs builds took 1st, a Top 4 spot and one more slot in the top lists.
Amber-Amethyst won Heroes Ink and also made Top 4 at both Heroes Ink and Top Deck Keep. Amber-Ruby took 2nd at Top Deck Keep. The Lore College says Amber-Ruby got real upgrades from Set 14.
At a 'Win 2 Cases' Hyperia City Core event in Italy, Amber-Emerald Circle and Amber-Amethyst Merida took most of the top spots.

The 16 QWIC invitational lists included three Amber-Emerald Songs decks, Emerald-Amethyst Retro (Alessandro Cavalli, Fungus), Amber-Steel Rockstar Stitch (vVonderland), Emerald-Sapphire (Lukas Kaupa) and Amethyst-Steel.

Flash is getting called a new Steel staple. Manifest made a video about it, and a Reddit thread called it overtuned: a 2-cost, 2-lore quester with Resist that punishes Rush decks. Manifest also rates Max Goof as one of the strongest cards in the set.

Off-meta brews to watch: Podcana built 15 Set 14 decks and asks whether Ruby-Emerald is real, and Ruby-Emerald Retro made the top lists at both weekend events. Xenulous also covered Emerald-Amethyst Retro on Alter Academy.

players.text: TT_Egelim won Heroes Ink 'Chapter 14 - Page 1' (October 24, Germany, 36 players) with Amber-Amethyst.
Darian won the 79-player Through The Decades CCQ Infinity 5K in the US on October 24. This feed doesn't include the deck's inks.

QWIC Round 1 included three-time champion Frank Karsten vs Shane Downey in an Emerald-Steel mirror that the host called one of the most technical he's seen. Other matches: Sky (Emerald-Ruby) vs R_M_B (Emerald-Steel), Fungus (Retro) vs Ace 103 (Emerald-Steel), and Diego 'Level 9001' Saz (Amethyst-Steel) vs Cav0 (Emerald-Sapphire).

news.text: Into the Inkdark (Set 15, villain-themed, brings in Onward) launches February 12, 2027. It comes with Collector Boosters: 12 special foils per pack and better Enchanted and Iconic odds. Six serialized Illustrious characters get 23 copies each (138 worldwide), starting with Maleficent – Biding Her Time. Set 15 card reveals have started.
Ravensburger is rereleasing the D23 2026 boxes and the foil Pooh playmat through an EQL raffle, with US and EU entry links.
Rules of Villainy flagged two dates: the Cauldron Cup CCQ survey closes October 30, and DLC Tampa tickets are on sale.
Pixelborn Connect now runs in a browser with ranked webcam games. It also has a streamer mode that hides your hand from your opponent so you can show it to viewers.

community.text: ICL Season 4 Round 6 'Infinity Week' streamed ETB vs Triad and World Class Cards vs Manifest. Decklists are on inkdecks.
Early Set 14 tier lists and breakdowns came from The Lore College, Podcana, Rules of Villainy (looking at Brennan DeCandio's decks) and Lorcana Villain's top 8 list reviews.

Reddit questioned pack value: one couple got no Enchanteds from two displays and found boosters with identical first commons. Another user's local store held back Hyperia stock to see how prices moved.
A deckbuilding thread asked why locations rarely show up in meta decks. It's a useful one to send to newer players.
